notes.md: - **Igarka:** timber-exporting port of **Russia** on the **Yenisei** river (Krasnoyarsk Krai, Siberia), north of the Arctic Circle; ocean-going ships reach it.
- **UNESCO Tentative List (AP):** **Sri Veerabhadra Temple and Monolithic Bull (Nandi), Lepakshi** (Sri Sathya Sai district) was added in **2022**.
- **Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga:** **Ujjain**, Madhya Pradesh, on the **Shipra** river; one of the 12 Jyotirlingas.
- **First US transcontinental:** **Union Pacific** (from **Omaha**) and **Central Pacific** (from **Sacramento**) met at **Promontory Summit, Utah**, on **10 May 1869** (Golden Spike).
- **ISM Dhanbad:** opened **9 December 1926** as the **Indian School of Mines** (modelled on the Royal School of Mines, London) for **mining and applied geology**; became **IIT (ISM)** in **2016**.
